data.name: Adila
data.gender_notes: Adila is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Feminine of ʿādil, from the Arabic root ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l), 'to be just'. Its root is ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l). A common Muslim female name. Adila is a Arabic name meaning “Just; fair; equitable”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Adila expresses “Just; fair; equitable”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Feminine of ʿādil, from the Arabic root ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l), 'to be just'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adila total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
